deadline.value: Applications open October 15, 2026 and close January 11, 2027; no late applications, and everything (including references) must be in by then.
deadline.quote: closes on January 11th, 2027. We do not accept applications after the closing deadline.

also.quote: Accepting applications for Fall 2027 start: October 15, 2026 – January 11, 2027

gre_general.value: GRE General and GRE Mathematics Subject scores are optional but recommended.
gre_general.quote: Optional: Submit any GRE General Test Results & GRE Mathematics Subject Test Results | These are recommended but not mandatory.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject test is optional but recommended.
gre_subject.quote: Optional: Submit any GRE General Test Results & GRE Mathematics Subject Test Results | These are recommended but not mandatory.

toefl_min.value: The Mathematics admissions page asks for TOEFL iBT 93 with at least 20 in each section, higher than the Graduate Studies minimum.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: The University minimum requirement for the internet-based exam is a total score of 93, with a minimum score of 20 in each category.

ielts_min.value: The Mathematics admissions page asks for IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each section.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: The University minimum requirements for English proficiency is an overall band score of 7.0 of the academic (NOT general) test with a minimum of 6.5 in each section.

supervisor.value: No supervisor is needed before applying; admitted students are matched with one, though you may contact faculty.
supervisor.quote: You will be matched with a supervisor who shares your research interests. You do not need to secure a supervisor prior to applying.

funding.value: PhD students are guaranteed at least CAD 30,000 a year for four years, plus an entrance scholarship of CAD 2,500-10,000.
funding.quote: PhD students: a minimum of $30,000 per year for the first four years | we guarantee a Special Graduate Entrance Scholarship valued between $2,500 and $10,000 to each admitted student

entry_route.value: PhD applicants should hold a master's degree with CGPA 3.5; SFU MSc students may sometimes transfer early.
entry_route.quote: If you are applying to the PhD program, you should have completed a Master’s degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.5 or equivalent.

notes: Covers the PhD in Mathematics and the PhD in Applied and Computational Mathematics.
